versions.changelog:
Initial release of google-analytics-intelligence skill.

- Analyze Google Analytics 4 (GA4) data for actionable insights and growth recommendations.
- Automatically detect traffic anomalies using statistical analysis.
- Generate professional reports with metrics, trends, and visualizations.
- Suggest tailored growth actions based on conversion and engagement data.
- Integrate with Slack for real-time alerts and daily/weekly summaries.
- Supports revenue tracking and optimization for websites, e-commerce, and mobile apps.
